basics.name: Jize Jiang
basics.label: Ph.D. Student, Computer Science
basics.summary: Ph.D. student in Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, advised by Prof. ChengXiang Zhai. Research interests include memory-augmented agents, post-train scaling for reasoning and tool use in LLM/VLMs, and evaluation and diagnostics for logical reasoning in LLMs.

work.name: TIMAN Research Group, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
work.summary: Advised by Prof. ChengXiang Zhai. Research on memory-augmented LLM agents, RL post-training for VLM reasoning and tool use, cost-effective VLM inference, knowledge-horizon evaluation, and diagnostic evaluation of logical reasoning in LLMs.

work.name: Automatic Reasoning Lab, Langboat Inc.
work.summary: Supervised by Dr. Ming Zhou. Surveyed and benchmarked low-resource semantic parsing and automatic reasoning approaches; built a neural-symbolic reasoning system for the AR-LSAT (Analytical Reasoning section of the Law School Admission Test) that integrates explicit logical rules with end-to-end differentiable training, outperforming baselines on ordering subtasks.

work.name: Microsoft Research Asia, System Intelligence Group
work.summary: Mentored by Yaming Yang. Researched transferable graph neural networks; developed ego-graph encoding techniques to produce richer node embeddings for cross-domain generalization; designed and evaluated structural encoding methods for heterogeneous graph settings.

work.name: Sanmi Koyejo Lab, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
work.summary: Mentored by Brando Miranda. Built IsabelleGym, a training and testing environment for automated theorem-proving agents. Worked on meta-learning a position evaluation function for proof complexity minimization. Developed Ultimate-pycoq, an ML interface for the Coq theorem prover.

work.name: Illinois Risk Lab, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
work.summary: Supervised by Dr. Zhiyu Frank Quan. Cleaned and preprocessed 500K business and insurance records; built keyword extraction and text classification models replacing the original rule-based pipeline; developed a question-answering system for risk-related queries over text and numerical sources.

publications.name: PlugMem: A Task-Agnostic Plugin Memory Module for LLM Agents
publications.summary: A task-agnostic plugin memory module that attaches to arbitrary LLM agents, structuring raw interactions into a memory graph of propositional facts and prescriptive skills with intent-aware retrieval.

publications.name: VTool-R1: VLMs Learn to Think with Images via Reinforcement Learning on Multimodal Tool Use
publications.summary: First framework training VLMs to produce multimodal chains of thought by interleaving text with intermediate visual reasoning steps via Python tool invocations, using outcome-based RL without process supervision.

publications.name: Cache-of-Thought: Master-Apprentice Framework for Cost-Effective Vision Language Model Inference
publications.summary: A master-apprentice framework where a large master VLM generates cached QA pairs retrieved via dual-modality dense retrieval to boost small apprentice VLMs through in-context learning.

publications.name: UOUO: Uncontextualized Uncommon Objects for Measuring Knowledge Horizons of Vision Language Models
publications.summary: A scalable benchmark and data curation pipeline for measuring VLM knowledge horizons on uncontextualized uncommon objects from long-tail visual distributions.

publications.name: Competence-Based Analysis of Language Models
publications.publisher: NeurIPS 2024 Workshop on Causality and Large Models (CaLM), Oral
publications.summary: A framework for analyzing the competence of language models.

publications.name: Aha Moment Revisited: Are VLMs Truly Capable of Self-Verification in Inference-time Scaling?
publications.summary: Systematic evaluation of self-verification capabilities in RL-tuned VLMs during inference-time scaling.

publications.name: Efficient Title Reranker for Fast and Improved Knowledge-Intense NLP
publications.summary: An efficient title reranker for fast and improved knowledge-intensive NLP.
